_comment: v1.6.2 (v1.5.9 base) — Section 09 executive films (one slot per card). Source of truth for scripts/v1.4.7/build.mjs (copies assets/<person>/ → dist/assets/exec/films/<person>/), dist/build-info.json (films[]), features/exec-films/exec-films.js (window.AtharExecFilms) and the QA suite. status: 'shipped' = file verified and served · 'coming-soon' = labelled ready slot, no file served. To ship a film later: drop the files into assets/<person>/, fill the entry, set status to shipped, run the build. burnedInSubtitles: whether the film itself carries burned-in captions (the <track> VTTs are shipped either way). v1.6.1: all four cards ship a film; no ready slot remains. v1.6.2: Khalid replaced by the delivered 50 s cut, served under content-hashed filenames. v1.6.4: fifth card — Lorenzo Avitabile (slide 45).

identity.roleLineOption: A — 'Senior Advisor' + 'Office of Development Affairs, UAE Presidential Court'
identity.method: the film's title-card portrait (credited 'portrait courtesy of Lorenzo Avitabile / LinkedIn') was compared with the og:image profile photo of the public LinkedIn profile ae.linkedin.com/in/lorenzo-avitabile using OpenCV YuNet face detection + SFace face recognition: cosine similarity 0.902 (same-identity threshold 0.363; normL2 0.443 ≤ 1.128); mid-film faces at 26 s and 37 s score 0.669 / 0.762 against the same photo; the film's own narration states 'his studies in Milan', 'more than a decade of professional experience' and 'his work at the UAE's Office of Development Affairs', matching the profile (MIP Politecnico di Milano · 'senior advisor with over a decade of experience' · Office of Development Affairs · Dubai)
identity.caveat: 'UAE Presidential Court' is the organisation line supplied with the task research (related posts); the film itself says 'the UAE's Office of Development Affairs'
